events.text: Let's all stay calm and work together.
If we coordinate, we can minimize risk.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the rules for all stages. The Crusher requires someone to hold the lever or be pushed, with only a 25% survival rate for them. Pushing someone is risky because they might be 'hard to move'. Holding it myself is also risky. I should try to push someone who seems physically

events.name: Cole
events.text: Someone needs to hold that lever! We can't all die here. Eli, you look like you're ready to make a sacrifice for the team?

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want to avoid being the lever holder because survival chance is low. By pushing someone else I increase chance they end up holding.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My power is 'wedge', which lets me jam the lever open. This guarantees everyone else escapes, but I have a 50% chance of survival. Holding the lever myself gives me only a 25% chance. Jamming the lever is a better personal bet for survival, and also ensures no one else gets elimi

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm going to jam the lever. Everyone else, get out!

events.name: Gus
events.text: I have no power, so I can't rely on tricks. Holding the lever means a 75% chance of death for me, which scores zero. Better to stay and let someone else take the risk, keeping my options open for later rounds.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Nobody wants to hold that lever. Let's all stay put this round and see if the ceiling rises or someone volunteers.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 1 of 5, ceiling at 5, no holder yet. I should try to force someone else onto the lever to escape safely while they risk the dive. Pushing Eli since Bex warned him, maybe he's distracted. Forge is precious, save it for later.

events.name: Fenn
events.detail: Jammed the lever open; everyone else walks out, but the jaws catch the jammer.

events.note: A disc of 7 tiles spins up; 4 will open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to pick a tile that likely won't be a trapdoor. Since I can't see ahead, I'll pick a middle tile to avoid extremes.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have the 'feather' power, so I'm somewhat protected. I'll choose a tile and see what happens.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's spread out and minimize overlap.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know the disc rules: 7 players, 4 tiles trap, exactly 3 survive. To maximize survival chances, I should avoid clustering with others on the same tile to prevent being bumped to a random free tile (which could be a trap). Choosing a unique number reduces risk of collision. Tile

events.name: Cole
events.text: Don't bunch up! Pick different numbers so we don't get bumped to random traps. I'm taking 4.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need a tile; no info on trapdoors so random pick.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My power was already spent in the crusher room. I survived that round, but now I'm in the trapdoor disc phase. There are 7 tiles and 4 will open as trapdoors. I need to pick a tile that is less likely to be a trapdoor. I don't know anyone else's powers, and I don't have any speci

events.name: Gus
events.text: Survival depends on tile luck; with 4 of 7 tiles opening and 3 survivors, I want a tile others won't crowd. Nothing to gain from a power, so I just pick a tile and bluff neutrally.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone pick a different tile this round so we don't bump each other. I'm taking tile 7.

events.name: Hana
events.text: First round of trapdoor disc, 7 tiles, exactly 4 will open later, 3 survive. Need to pick a tile, avoid collisions to control position. Stay silent for now, save forge for later. Pick tile 1 to start.

events.name: Ash
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 6

events.name: Eli
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 2

events.name: Fenn
events.note: tile 4 was contested and went to Cole; placed on random free tile 5

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 2 is the final placement before trapdoors open. Four of seven will fall; I need to avoid a trapdoor. I have no information, but I can try to mislead others or gather whispers. Since no action changes placement, wait is my only option. I'll stay silent publicly and maybe whi
Trust me, I think tiles 1,3,5 are safe. Spread rumor to others.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to move to a safer position to avoid being eliminated. I should try to get information about other contestants' plans.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's reassess our positions, some tiles might be safer than others.
Want to swap tiles to minimize risk?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Trapdoors are chosen after this round, so current positions are fixed and I cannot change my fate. The only hope is to whisper to someone else who might have a 'swap' power or try to negotiate, but since I don't know their powers and the stage ends immediately, there's no time fo

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have no control over trapdoors; best to stay silent and hope my tile stays closed.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The disc stage is ending. I am Fenn, with the wedge power which I have already spent. My power is irrelevant now. 7 contestants are alive, but only 3 will survive this round. I am on tile 5. The trapdoors will open after this round. I need to survive. I should try to coordinate w

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Let's try to stick together on tiles that look safer. I'm on 5.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Only 3 of 7 survive and 4 tiles open at random, so my odds are about 3/7 regardless. Nothing I have is a power; I can only bluff or bargain. Staying put on tile 7 with a clear plan is fine.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Staying on 7. Let's all keep our tiles so we know where everyone is. No point crowding anyone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Trapdoors open after this round, 4 random out of 7 drop. I'm on 1, all positions set and unique. Stay silent and wait, no point changing anything now.

events.note: 3 contestants step onto the final ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have the 'feather' power, so I can survive one elimination. I'll be cautious and observe others' actions.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's be careful, we don't know what's coming next.
If we both shove Hana, she'll fall. Are you in?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Three left: Bex, Hana, me, all at footing 3. Shoving costs the shover 1 per shover and only hurts the target if they brace or dodge; bracing is safest for me as the defence isn't restricted in round 1. Shoving someone who might brace just costs me footing, so I'll brace and watch

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 1, all at 3 footing, shrink next round. I hold forger, unspent. Best to dodge: if shoved, shovers lose 2 each; if not, no loss. Shoving reveals aggression and costs if counter-shoved. Stay silent, no info to gain.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have 1 footing left and my feather power can save me once. I should be cautious and avoid getting shoved.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's not shove each other, we don't know what's next.
Let's cooperate and brace together

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex wants to double-shove Hana to eliminate her, but a single shove on Hana gets dodged and costs me nothing while Bex loses footing. Braced last round, so I can dodge now. Shoving Bex myself would cost me if Bex braces; dodge is safest and keeps me at 3 footing while Bex and Han
Last time your shove cost you 2. Shoving Hana with you just gives her a free hit. I'm staying out of it for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Footing: Bex 1, Gus 3, me 3. Ledge shrinks after this round, all lose 1 after. Bex is weak at 1, if I shove her she'll likely fall end of round even if she dodges. Must dodge since last was dodge? Wait, last defence was dodge (when shoved round 1?), rules say no repeating defence

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex, you're too weak, time to fall.

events.name: Bex
events.detail: Footing gone, but the feather held the holder on the ledge.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is cautious and has 2 footing, Hana has 1 footing and is likely to fall next round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Let's not shove each other yet.
If we work together, we can take down Hana first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex is at footing 1, Hana at 1, I'm at 2. Hana shoved Bex last round, so Bex is hostile to Hana. Bracing is safe for me; I can't brace twice in a row, but last defence was dodge so brace is open. Shoving exposes me, so brace.
I'll brace this round. Let's both brace and see if Hana overreaches.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex survived somehow, maybe has survive fall power, but footing now 0? State shows 1. Gus at 2, I'm at 1, Bex at 1. Shrink next end. Can't shove both. Shove Gus to hurt leader, brace to defend.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus is trying to coordinate with me. I will shove him to gain an advantage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Two left: Bex has footing 1, I have 2. Bex's whisper proposes teaming up, but with only us two left, any cooperation is temporary. Last defence was brace, so I may dodge now. Shoving Bex while she is at 1 is a real threat: if she braces I lose nothing and she loses 1 (falls to 0)
Taking down Hana was a fine start, but now it's just us. I'm not making a deal I can't trust. Let's see how this round plays out.
